title: Chapter 5: Ashfall
_comment: Chapter 5 remodel (2026-09-10, v2): map tripled in each dimension (was 58x32). The most different shape yet - deliberately NOT another big sealed maze. A modest single graveyard maze (Mourning Row) sits right at the entrance, then opens into one huge OPEN ruined district with no maze walls at all - scattered named ruin clusters, wandering hostiles, riddle-keepers and a hostage placed freely across open ground instead of threaded through corridor cells. Layout: the edge of Ashfall (cols 2-28), Mourning Row - the one small maze (30-70, full playable height), the open burnt district (72-172).
